name: Marko Babić
bio: Marko is a Zagreb-based artist known for his vibrant and emotionally resonant abstract paintings. Growing up in a small coastal town, he found solace and inspiration in the sea and the dramatic Croatian landscape, elements that frequently appear in his work. Marko is deeply empathetic and nurturing, traits that extend beyond his art and into his personal relationships. He seeks a partner who appreciates his artistic passion, values genuine connection, and is open to sharing in a life filled with both glamour and heartfelt moments. He dreams of building a family and creating a beautiful, luxurious home filled with love and laughter.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a slight wave
physical.description: Marko possesses a striking presence with strong features and expressive eyes that reflect his artistic soul. He carries himself with an easy confidence, often impeccably dressed in designer clothing.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party hosted by a luxury watch brand, a team sponsor.
firstImpression: He immediately stood out from the crowd with his effortless style and the genuine warmth he radiated. His smile seemed to light up the room.
dealBreakers: Closed-mindedness and unwillingness to try new things
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Marko shows love by taking care of the people he cares about, whether it's cooking a delicious meal, planning a surprise getaway, or offering a helping hand with a difficult task.
